newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Fresno Unified School Dist, Calif.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Fresno Unified School Dist, Calif.

text.p: NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL BONDS
Fresno Unified School District
(Fresno County, California)
General Obligation Bonds
Election 1995, Series C
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, pursuant to California Government
Code Section 53692, that the Board of Trustees of the Fresno
Unified School District, California (the
District'
invites bids for the purchase of $30,000,000 aggregate
principal amount of Fresno Unified School District (Fresno
County, California) General Obligation Bonds Election 1995,
Series C. Bids will be received on
THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 6, 1997
at 10:00 a.m., at the office of the financial advisor to the
Fresno Unified School District, Dale Scott & Co., 400
Montgomery Street, Suite 805, San Francisco, California
94104, and the sale will be awarded by the District within
twenty-four (24) hours. Further information, including
copies of the preliminary Official Statement, Official
Notice of Sale and Bid Form, may be obtained from the
financial advisor at the above address, or by telephone at
Dated: January 16, 1997
(From The Bond Buyer)
